name: expensesnap
description: ExpenseSnap — aplicação pessoal para registo e organização de despesas.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && playwright test --ui
